title: Entropic smoothing and gradient approximation for Wasserstein distributionally robust optimization
abstract: arXiv:2506.04948v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Wasserstein distributionally robust optimization offers a framework for model fitting in machine learning under potential shifts in the data distribution. We study a regularized variant of this problem in which entropic smoothing produces a sampled approximation of the original objective. We establish convergence of the approximate gradients to subgradients of the unregularized objective as the regularization parameter vanishes, enabling convergence guarantees for stochastic gradient methods. We obtain qualitative convergence results under general assumptions and provide convergence rates under additional regularity. In particular, we prove rates for the convergence of the unregularized objective values, up to sampling errors, when the regularization level is decreased across iterations. Our analysis also yields results of independent interest on approximating the subdifferentials of maximum functions by gradients of their smoo

translated_title: 面向Wasserstein分布鲁棒优化的熵平滑与梯度近似
translated_abstract: Wasserstein分布鲁棒优化为机器学习中数据分布潜在变化下的模型拟合提供了一个框架。我们研究了该问题的一个正则化变体，其中熵平滑产生了原始目标的采样近似。我们建立了当正则化参数趋于消失时，近似梯度收敛到未正则化目标次梯度的理论结果，从而为随机梯度方法提供了收敛保证。我们在一般假设下获得了定性收敛结果，并在额外的正则性条件下给出了收敛速率。特别地，我们证明了当正则化水平在迭代过程中逐渐降低时，未正则化目标值的收敛速率（直至采样误差）。我们的分析还产生了具有独立意义的结果，即用最大值函数的平滑版本的梯度来近似其次微分。
tldr: 本文证明了Wasserstein分布鲁棒优化的熵平滑正则化变体的近似梯度在正则化参数趋于零时收敛到原问题的次梯度，从而为随机梯度方法提供了收敛保证与收敛速率。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that the approximate gradients of an entropically smoothed Wasserstein distributionally robust optimization problem converge to subgradients of the unregularized objective, yielding convergence guarantees and rates for stochastic gradient methods.
